frases: Your gate is going to sag!
You built a nice square frame, hung it on two hinges, and went inside for lemonade.
It pulls down on the far corner, and the square slowly turns into a lean.
A few months later, it drags on the ground!
It runs from the bottom, on the hinge side, up to the top, on the latch side.
Now the weight pushes straight down the brace, and into the post.
Same gate. Same hinges. Smooth swing!
